name: Georgia
sources: 2026 rate 4.99%, standard deduction $15,000 / $30,000, dependent exemption $5,000 (HB 463): Georgia DOR 2026 Employer's Tax Guide (updated June 2026), https://dor.georgia.gov/document/document/2026-employers-tax-guide-updated-june-2026/download

Itemizing rules (must match federal choice, state income tax removed, $10,000 / $5,000 SALT limit), no 65+ add-on, retirement exclusion: 2025 IT-511 booklet, https://dor.georgia.gov/document/document/2025-it-511-individual-income-tax-booklet/download and 2025 Form 500, https://apps.dor.ga.gov/FillableForms/webpdf/examples/2025GA500.pdf
SALT limit stays at $10,000 (HB 1199, 2026 IRC conformity): https://gscpa.org/content/Home/News/Professional-News/News-Alert--Governor-Signs-Georgia-Conformity-Bill--HB-1199--into-Law-.aspx
provisional: Itemizing rules (medical floor, SALT limit mechanics) are from the 2025 IT-511 booklet; the 2026 booklet is not yet published.
notes: Filers 62+ can exclude $35,000 (65+: $65,000) each of retirement income, including interest, dividends and gains; that exclusion is not included.
Georgia's $10,000 tax-deduction limit is applied to property tax alone; Georgia's own proration formula can allow less.
